verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's own README lists screenshots as a supported output format, so the core capability exists. Nothing in the evidence documents full-page capture versus capturing a specific selected area. The community comment only asks whether screenshots are supported and does not contradict the README. Missing for 10: documentation of full-page screenshot mode, selector/area-specific screenshot capture, screenshot API parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture a screenshot of a full page or a specific selected area

citations.quote: LLM-ready output: Clean markdown, structured JSON, screenshots, and more
